h1: Store analytics Q&A, ask in plain words and get an answer
overview: Reports are slow when you just need an answer. We connect your store data to a question box where you can type things like which products sold best last month or how many customers ordered twice. It answers in plain words with a small table or chart and shows how it worked the answer out. Your data stays in your own accounts, and the helper only reads it.

faq: We test with questions where you already know the right answer, and every reply shows its working so you can check it. Treat unusual results as a prompt to look closer.
The helper only reads the data you connect, inside your own accounts, with limited access. We tell you which tool processes the questions and where, before we begin.
Which platforms and tools can it connect to?
Shopify, WooCommerce, Google Sheets, Google Analytics exports and ad platform exports are typical. Tell us what you have and we confirm what is possible.
Can it change things in my store?
No. It can only read and answer. It has no permission to edit products, prices or orders, so nothing can be changed by accident from a question.
